profile.headline: Software Developer/Architect, Engineering Manager
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with experience in embedded systems using C/C++, in Linux, FreeRTOS, and micro-kernel (seL4), using design patterns, and concurrency; with a strong interest in developing high-performance teams.  Worked with international teams from Americas, Europe, and Asia, across functions from R&D to production and distribution.

•	Technical leadership/management
•	Mentor and team builder.
•	Architect
•	Strong in C/C++, patterns, git.
•	Experience with Agile, TDD
•	Working knowledge of Python and C#.

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer/Architect
positions.description:
Technical lead for multiple firmware components in printers and copiers
•	Designed a new job architecture for the next generation of printers
•	Improved log information and created tools for failure analysis reducing backlog by over 80% in less than 1 month and increasing response time on new failures to minutes from hours
•	Mentored and developed ~ 10 HP engineers and interns
•	Developed and recorded training material for remote engineering team on FW architecture, protocols of operations, how to debug and multiple other topics to onboard new engineers
positions.insights: Software Development, Embedded Systems and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Designed and built Simulation and Emulation tools for printer development.
•	Created management system for deployed emulations systems, reporting system information, and providing remote FW updates, reducing user calls by 90%
•	Saved at least $100,000 per program by envisioning the remote ‘farm’ concept for emulators to allow worldwide access to them via internet, including defining product features needed for remote development and testing, enabling sharing expensive resources
•	Refactored FPGA to allow use of older inventory, saving near $50,000
•	Turned around team performance through engagement and coaching, addressing department roadblocks and improving morale of the team

positions.title: R&D SW Development Section Manager
positions.description:
Reported to R&D Director in HP Mexico and established new FW R&D Section
•	Created central FW team changing the existing product development structure
•	Reduced development cycle for new products from 2 years to 4 months (production ready)
•	Drove software update capabilities in the products that saved about $250,000 per year
•	Negotiated charter with HP US and became a resource to established US team
•	Developed architecture, frameworks and libraries shared by multiple groups in HP
•	Managed 20 engineers, including contractors, and 2 project managers
•	Responsible for an annual budget of $2M US
